name: TransferDispatchPlanner
tagline: Flight-linked airport, cruise, hotel and tour transfers – dispatched, timed and checked in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete ground transfer dispatch app for DMCs, hotel transport desks, tour operators and chauffeur services. Pickups follow the latest flight ETA (arrival buffer, meet & greet) or the departure lead time, delays are re-timed in one click, drivers and vehicles are assigned on a drag-and-drop timeline with capacity, wheelchair and double-booking checks, and waiting and no-show rules keep billing honest.
features: Pickup timing from the latest ETA + arrival buffer + meet & greet, or back from the departure
Delay detection and one-click re-time per flight or for all flights
Set ETA from the flight feed on every job of a flight
Drag-and-drop driver timeline with unassigned lane, overlaps and flight ghosts
Vehicle suggestion by class, seats, bags and availability
Capacity, wheelchair-accessibility and driver / vehicle double-booking checks
Dispatch deadline, late start and duty-hours warnings
Waiting time, chargeable wait and no-show rules
Status board Booked → Assigned → On the way → Waiting → In transit → Completed
Bulk assign / move / re-time / export with Undo
Canvas, model-driven and Power Pages (Web API) versions
controlType: standard (2 controls: TransferDispatchPlanner data-set + TransferDispatchPlannerPortal field)
